narrative:
Comparable cost-to-income is 62.6% year-to-date and 66% in Q3, against a target below 60%; the 9+3 forecast is 63.2%, and ROE of 12.7% is only above the 12% target because of the credit-loss release (11.0% underlying). Income is €12.2M behind budget (NII −€7.5M, other −€3.5M, life insurance −€2.7M, commissions +€1.5M) and comparable costs are €4.4M over. A €3.5M credit-loss release instead of a €12.3M charge keeps operating profit near guidance.

The path back below 60%: about €11.3M of income (AUM +5%, Euribor +25 bp as hedges roll, MOPS price list +3%) and €6.5M of cost (Oracle decommission, purchased services, 15 open positions) — CIR 58.7%, ROE 14.9% (13.3% with normal credit losses).
